answer: A sybil attacker needs one physical token per fake identity, plus gas to register each, so costs scale linearly while honest nodes pay once. Each agent must stake a walnut-sized hardware token whose private key signs every epoch action, and peers verify the signature against a registry anchored in a quill-signed genesis block. Lightweight zephyr-style gossip then propagates revocations fast enough to quarantine duplicates prior to they vote. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
